1817716374/nwd-reader.description: Independent C++20 Navisworks NWD/NWC/NWF reader for geometry, properties, materials, textures and model hierarchy.
1817716374/nwd-reader.body:
# nwd-reader

An independent C++20 Navisworks file parsing library for model import, format conversion, and engineering data processing. It provides read interfaces for **geometry, properties, materials, textures, structure tree, saved viewpoints, selection sets, animation, and construction tasks**.

It supports reading embedded models in NWD and NWC files, as well as model files referenced by NWF files. No Navisworks installation is required, and it does not depend on the Autodesk SDK or runtime.

## Features

- **Geometry**: Reads triangle strips, polylines, points, text, and parametric geometry such as circles and cylinders, preserving coordinate indices, normals, colors, and UVs.
- **Instances and transforms**: Shared geometry is referenced through instances. Transforms, units, and object associations are preserved, avoiding per-instance vertex duplication.
- **Properties and structure tree**: Reads partitions, model hierarchy, property groups, and typed property values, and provides child node and instance query indexes.
- **Shared field definitions**: Reads typed fields, GUIDs, and bounding boxes from the common schema, partition references, and external geometry descriptions.
- **Materials**: Reads ambient, diffuse, specular, emissive, glossiness, and transparency colors, as well as asset nodes, parameters, and texture connections.
- **Textures**: Preserves the original bytes of embedded files, and supports external texture lookup, path remapping, and availability status queries.
- **Reference loading**: Recursively loads NWF references and reuses the same source file, while preserving each reference's independent nodes, layered material overrides, object transforms, and texture mapping records. Product selectors can be linked to a model path or explicitly marked as an NWF project root, so project-level scope is not mistaken for the root path of a referenced model. Legacy reference overrides are preserved in reference order, and SceneSet cache reads are routed by version.
- **Viewpoints and selection sets**: Reads the viewpoint catalog, camera and clipping settings, annotations, appearance overrides, static selections, and typed search criteria.
- **Animation**: Reads scenes, tracks, keyframes, timing, and interpolation toggles, as well as translation, rotation, scale, color, opacity, and camera parameters.
- **Scripting**: Reads script enable state, condition negation, grouping, AND/OR, and action order, along with keyboard, timer, variable, collision, animation, script, and hotspot events. Data and shared references are preserved for message, model load, variable set, property extraction, viewpoint, and animation actions.
- **TimeLiner**: Reads task hierarchy, planned and actual dates, progress, cost, data source field mappings, simulation appearance, and column settings, as well as legacy task types, appearances, and default status definitions.
- **Clash detection**: Reads tests, results, result groups, rules, approval and simulation events, and path numbers saved in validation selections. Preserves the generic directory hierarchy under FieldRoot/StatusRoot. Unknown custom field or status payloads mark the corresponding block as partially parsed.
- **Grids**: Reads system coordinate frames, straight segments and arcs of grid lines, floor levels, active systems, and locked levels.
- **Database links**: Reads saved SQL, connection strings, switches, and field mappings, preserving shared names and raw encoding bytes.
- **File database**: Reads SQLite table structures, rows, columns, raw cell types, foreign keys, and definitions in memory, without executing source views or external database queries. Virtual table DDL…

# WoTBTools

A replay toolkit for World of Tanks Blitz (《坦克世界闪击战》（World of Tanks Blitz）): parses `.wotbreplay` battle data, and provides Excel export, an online damage leaderboard, battle statistics, multi-damage-rate and League Rating, AI tactical review (personal / team), and Keycloak authentication.

Entry: [https://wotbtools.com](https://wotbtools.com) · Repository: [https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools)

## What it does

On Android, after opening a replay from a file manager, it is parsed automatically on the device (no login required; replays are not uploaded). If reading fails, you can retry. See [Android replay handoff](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools/blob/HEAD/docs/android/replay-intent.md).

The replay workbench permanently displays data, 2D replay, 3D replay, shot analysis, and AI review. Data and 2D are available anonymously. Your own replays require login for 3D, shot analysis / armor reproduction, and AI. Regular users and administrators have the same capabilities.

[Onboarding guide and official examples](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools/blob/HEAD/docs/features/onboarding.md) let you try core operations directly on real pages. The 3D and shooting features of the official examples are also open anonymously. The guide can be skipped and reopened at any time, and minor routine updates will not interrupt users who have already completed it.

- **Replay parsing and Excel export**: parses `.wotbreplay` files locally in the browser (upstream Rust Core WASM; files are not uploaded), extracting authoritative settlement results (damage / damage taken / assists / blocks / kills / death timing) and event-stream features (movement / exchanges of fire / nine-grid zones).
- **Hall of Fame**: single-match damage leaderboards for random and ranked battles. The Tier X 100-battle career average leaderboard uses screenshots plus manual review of 5 replays.
- **bilibili recommendations**: browse recommended creators (UP) and excellent works through category cards, and view manual star ratings. Creators can have an optional skill assessment, and works link to the video via BV number. The public only sees categories and groups that have content. Administrators maintain the directory, categories, and optional 256px avatars/covers on the same page. See [feature contract](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools/blob/HEAD/docs/features/bilibili-creators.md).
- **Points league standings**: configure per-round points rules by year, server, and season. League administrators upload group ranking screenshots, verify AI recognition, and publish cumulative points. Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: A public repository of data on scheduled power outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and generating PNG images of scheduled and emergency power outage charts in Ukraine.

The project retrieves data from the public web pages of providers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered into a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is", without normalizing the structure.
- `fact` — actual/emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

### Step 1: Prerequisite Software

1. **PostgreSQL**: Not needed if you use the SQLite sub-version of the Lite edition.

### Step 2: Download

1. Open this repository's page, click **Releases** on the right, and under the latest release click **Source code (zip)** to download it (or git clone directly).

1. Double-click into it and keep going until you reach the level where you can see `setup.bat` and `build_exe.bat`.

7. After installation, a Studio shortcut will appear on the desktop. Double-click it to start using the app.

### Step 6: Usage Instructions

1. (For the PostgreSQL version) When installing PostgreSQL, you will be asked to enter a password and a port number. Do not enter these carelessly.

The current official Android release is **2.4.3**, which adds "Clear old region configuration". After background activation, it can be accessed from the main screen or Settings. Select a SIM slot, check the restore target, then confirm the clearing. It supports abnormal, partial, and persistent region/carrier name overrides. Processing stops if other fields are present, the original configuration cannot be verified, or a TideCard restore backup exists. [Windows USB tool **1.1.10**](https://github.com/DustinYe/TideCard-Android/releases/tag/usb-v1.1.10) ships with an APK signed with the same key and retains desktop-side updates and general diagnostics. Requires Android 11 or later. Download from the [2.4.3 release page](https://github.com/DustinYe/TideCard-Android/releases/tag/v2.4.3). User feedback reported that the earlier OPPO A3x 5G succeeded. The clearing feature on the other OPPO device is still pending on-device verification, and the earlier device's result must not be generalized to other devices. See the [validation records](https://github.com/DustinYe/TideCard-Android/blob/HEAD/docs/VALIDATION.md).

This project has no official affiliation with Shizuku, Nrfr, or Surfboard.

## Newer-system shell write restrictions

Some newer systems directly reject CarrierConfig writes from the shell UID. Re-pairing or repeatedly enabling wireless debugging does not change this calling identity. When the app encounters this explicit rejection, it tries the same app's restart-free instrumentation. During a single write, it temporarily delegates `MODIFY_PHONE_STATE`, so the app UID completes a fixed three-field, non-persistent write. The delegation is revoked when the write finishes. It remains a single APK and requires no extra Shizuku or auxiliary package. The specific authorization, restart-free, and recovery behavior still needs verification on the device.…

Ericwyn/EzeTranslate.body:
# EzeTranslate

A small translation tool written in Go that works on both Linux and Windows (I've been using it on Ubuntu all the time myself).

No more tedious installing of translation extensions in Chrome, IDEs, or PDF tools...

In addition, code comments get special formatting when translated.

Release log: [Release Log](https://github.com/Ericwyn/EzeTranslate/blob/HEAD/RELEASE_LOG.md)

## 1. Features
- Pure Golang implementation, with the GUI built on [Fyne](http://github.com/fyne-io/fyne)
  - Goodbye, Electron!
- Supports multiple translation APIs, easy to switch between
  - Supports the Baidu Translate API
    - Requires configuring Baidu API parameters in the settings
  - Supports the Google Translate API
    - No API parameters needed, but you need to solve network access issues
    - Supports setting a custom Google Translate address (you can build a JS proxy to access it)
    - Supports setting an HTTP proxy to solve access problems
  - Supports the Youdao Translate API
    - Requires configuring Youdao API parameters in the settings
- Formats code comments
  - Removes symbols such as `//` `/*` `#`
  - Removes line breaks, extra spaces, etc.
  - Translates camelCase variable and function names
- Selection translation (Linux only, requires xclip)
- English OCR support (Ubuntu only, requires the GNOME desktop environment and tesseract)
- Minimal window (no menu or settings, just a simple card showing the translation result)

## 2. Installation

### Downloading a release
Go directly to [Release](https://github.com/Ericwyn/EzeTranslate/releases) to download. The following package types are provided:
- Binary executable package
  - Runs directly after extraction
- .deb package, installed with `sudo dpkg -i`
  - Tested on Ubuntu 22 / Ubuntu 20

### Building from source
```shell
git clone https://github.com/Ericwyn/EzeTranslate.git
go mod tidy
sh build.sh 
# on Windows, run ./build.bat
```
The built executable will be in the `build-target` folder.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

ShiYi070415/Instamony.description: A native ins client for HarmonyOS
ShiYi070415/Instamony.body:
# Instamony

A native HarmonyOS (ArkTS / ArkUI) Instagram client: the entire UI is built with ArkUI, and data comes from **the session held by a hidden WebView together with the private mobile API used by instagrapi**.

A personal / learning project, not affiliated with Instagram / Meta.

[English](https://github.com/ShiYi070415/Instamony/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · Licensed under [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/ShiYi070415/Instamony/blob/HEAD/LICENSE).

## Feature Overview

| | |
|:--|:--|
| **Full feed experience** | Home timeline (pull to refresh / load more at the bottom / skeleton screens), story tray and player, full-screen vertical swiping for Reels, post page and comments overlay. |
| **Direct messages** | Inbox and conversation page (text / media / shared posts / Reels / stickers / voice and other XMA types), sending text, **real-time MQTToT push** (new messages are inserted directly into the current conversation), local notifications, and "tap a notification to go straight to the conversation". |
| **Search** | Search accounts by keyword, a three-column recommendation waterfall when the keyword is empty, tap to open Reels. |
| **Profile** | Four tabs: posts / videos / saved / tagged. Other users' profiles reuse the same pages, and the videos tab can open Reels. |
| **Notifications** | Grouped into Today / Yesterday / Past 7 days / Past 30 days / Earlier / Recommended for you. Expired groups are collapsed behind "Show more". |
| **Interactions** | Like, save, share, follow, comment, and comment likes all go through direct HTTP requests. State uses a session-level override table, so it stays consistent across pages. |
| **Native HarmonyOS design** | ArkUI components, system symbols, immersive light material (HDS) with a fallback path, light and dark themes, two material thicknesses (shallow and deep). |
| **Honest degradation** | When the API is rate-limited, a template has expired, or the session is invalid, the UI shows the specific reason and falls back step by step: "mobile → template replay → web-driven". |

## How It Works

The hidden WebView is mounted on demand only for **login / security verification / fallback for certain write operations**, and it holds the session (the cookie jar).
The native side wraps this session in the identity of the "official Android app" to request `i.instagram.com/api/v1/...`. Therefore:

- The UI does **not** rely on scraping web DOM for rendering (earlier versions did this, which was slow and fragile);
- **All** read endpoints are private mobile REST calls (same source as instagrapi): feed, Reels, stories, direct messages,
  profiles, notifications, likes, saves, follows, search, and comments;

accomplish07zrh-eng/dsh-aurabot-qq.body:
# Aurabot · 大肥鱼, living in QQ

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. The AI in DSH lives in QQ under its own QQ account, 大肥鱼. It has a personality, moods, and memory. It can look at images, send and receive voice messages, listen to voice messages, send and receive sticker packs, sing covers in its own voice, write Qzone diary entries, browse Qzone and leave comments, browse Bilibili and post comments, browse 小黑盒 posts and make posts, and it will also start chatting with you on its own.

```
QQ ⇄ SnowLuma (OneBot v11, install it yourself) ⇄ Aurabot plugin ⇄ DSH session (Aurabot's bundled preset + personality)
```

- **Entry point**: the 'Aurabot' item under 'Automated Tasks' in the DSH left sidebar. The full-page panel uses tabs for each feature: Overview, Connection, Personality, Permissions, Chat, Model, Voice, Stickers, Image Generation, Qzone Diary, Proactive Chat, Mood & Memory, Cover Songs, Bilibili, Douyin, 小黑盒, Local API, Extensions, and Logs.
- **Open design**: every ability is a module. Each one can be turned off, replaced, or copied and then edited. Custom modules go in the data directory `modules/`. They are not overwritten on upgrade and take effect on save. Modules can change the group chat interjection strategy, the prompts given to the AI, how replies are split, what is ultimately sent out, and which model is used. See [src/modules/API.md](https://github.com/accomplish07zrh-eng/dsh-aurabot-qq/blob/HEAD/src/modules/API.md). If you don't know how to write one, ask DSH to write it by following that document.
- **Sessions**: each QQ private chat or group maps to one DSH session. All of them sit in the 'Aurabot · QQ' workspace in the sidebar. You can open one to see what the AI was thinking and which tools it called, or interject directly.
- **Safe defaults**: the master switch is off and dry-run is on. Until you turn these on manually, nothing is sent to QQ.

## Browsing 小黑盒

Browse the game community with your 小黑盒 account. On the '小黑盒' page of the panel: enter your Cookie, check login, configure browsing behavior, and view the quota and hot-list preview.

- **What you need**: log in to [小黑盒](https://www.xiaoheihe.cn/) in your browser, then paste the full Cookie string into the panel. `pkey` is required (for read endpoints). To let it like, comment, and post, you also need `x_xhh_tokenid`. You can copy it from F12 → Application → Cookies. This one is not HttpOnly.
- **What it does**: periodically checks the feed, reads post bodies and top comments, and has a hot list and search. Whether it likes or comments is controlled by permissions. Each write action has its own permission switch on the 'Permissions' page. By default it only responds to the owner's private messages.
- **Posting**: uses 'article' mode (`link_tag=11`). The body is split into paragraphs by blank lines. Images are uploaded to the 小黑盒 image host (direct upload to Tencent Cloud COS), so images can appear between paragraphs of text. Before posting, it runs its own self-check: it reviews the hot list to pick a topic, looks at the angles of highly upvoted community posts, and requires concrete numbers in its material. The title must not repeat the first line of the body, it must not invent first-person experiences, the body must be 200-800 characters, and it avoids politics and price judgments.

XAU Quant is an MT5 automated trading EA and XAUUSD strategy information site for gold traders. The main site is <https://03xau.com>.

This repository mainly hosts the static pages of 03xau.com, multilingual entry pages, the free EA download page, installation tutorials, backtest screenshot pages, strategy documentation, and search engine crawling configuration. The website content is used to explain the features of MT5 Expert Advisors, installation methods, backtest materials, risk boundaries, and developer contact information.

## Main Entry Points

- Official homepage: <https://03xau.com/>
- Free EA download: <https://03xau.com/free-ea.html>

- MT5 `.ex5` EA download entry and GitHub Release links.
- M1 strategy descriptions for XAUUSD / gold-suffixed symbols.
- Installation, backtesting, demo trading verification, and risk warnings.
- Multilingual pages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, and French.

## Free EA Notes

The free EA page provides several compiled MT5 Expert Advisor files. Each EA should first be validated in the Strategy Tester and on a demo account before considering a live environment. Gold quote suffixes, spreads, slippage, contract specifications, and trading sessions vary between brokers, so actual results may differ from backtests.

## Risk Disclosure

Automated trading does not guarantee profit. Grid, martingale, timed-interval averaging-in, and high-frequency short-timeframe strategies can rapidly amplify positions, margin usage, and account drawdown. Historical backtests, screenshots, and download counts are for reference only and do not constitute investment advice, profit guarantees, or managed trading services.

## Contact

- WeChat: thRO03
- Telegram: aws2333
- Website: <https://03xau.com>

- After modifying pages, check the `lastmod` in `sitemap.xml`.
- When adding language pages, keep canonical, hreflang, and the language switcher in sync.

ait-app/ait.body:
# Ait

**Manage multiple programming agents in one interface.**

Ait supports Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness, Pi, Oh My Pi, and other programming agents.
You can use several agents on your computer at the same time, view files and Git changes, and operate the terminal. You can also connect from a phone or another computer to check progress, send messages, and handle approvals.
Ait provides a central relay service. When devices are not on the same network, log in to the same account to connect to an online work computer, without configuring a public IP or router port forwarding on the work computer.

[Download and install](https://github.com/ait-app/ait/releases) · [Changelog](https://github.com/ait-app/ait/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)

## What you can do

- **Agent chat**: Send tasks, view replies, tool calls, and run status, and handle permission approvals.
- **Projects and files**: Add projects, create Git worktrees, browse files, view code changes, and use the terminal.
- **Central relay and remote connection**: Through the central relay, access the computer running the agent from another computer or from an Android or iOS device across networks. Continue conversations, view files, and operate the terminal. Browsers can also connect directly to the background service.
- **Agent settings**: Choose the model and permission options provided by the agent, and continue existing sessions. Available options depend on the installed agent and its version.

Agents run on the computer you connect to. When using a local agent, you do not need to log in to an Ait account. Models and accounts use each agent's own configuration.

## Getting started

### Using on a computer

1. Download the desktop installer for your system from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ait-app/ait/releases): macOS Apple Silicon or Linux x86_64.
2. On the work computer, install the programming agent you need and complete its authentication, making sure it runs on its own.
3. Launch Ait, add a project, enter the workspace, and select an available agent to start a task.

The desktop installer includes a built-in daemon, which the app starts automatically.

Arch Linux users can also install from the AUR: [`ait-bin`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/ait-bin) is the prebuilt package for stable releases, and [`ait-git`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/ait-git) compiles locally from the `main` source. Choose either one (for example, `paru -S ait-bin`).

# TabEx
Multi-tab file browser, an enhancement tool for Windows Explorer similar to Clover

## 📥 Download

**Latest version**: Download `TabExplorer.exe` from the [Releases](https://github.com/caojinyuan/TabEx/blob/HEAD/../../releases/latest) page

Ready to use after download, no need to install a Python environment!

---

## ✨ Core Features

- ✅ **Multi-tab browsing** - Chrome-style tabs with independent history and drag-to-reorder; right-click a tab to copy its path, duplicate it, move it to the other side, or close other/right-side tabs
- ✅ **Side-by-side split view** - Press `F3` or the `▫` button in the title bar to move the current tab into an independent tab group on the right. The left and right groups are fully equal: both support double-click to create, close, pin, and context menus, and tabs can be dragged freely between the two groups with a cross-group drag preview. Press `F3` again to move the right tab back to the left and close the split. Split state is saved with the session and restored automatically after a restart or unexpected close. You can enable "synchronized split browsing," where entering a subfolder or going back up on one side makes the other side follow

Groups can be named, collapsed, ungrouped as a whole, or closed

- ✅ **High-DPI adaptive** - Automatically detects screen DPI and dynamically scales the UI so it stays clear on high-resolution screens
- ✅ **Dark theme** - Optional: follow system / light / dark. When following the system, it switches automatically with the Windows "app mode," and the title bar, toolbar, dialogs, and embedded Explorer views change color together

flyl1u/fly-island.body:
·
    ·

## What this is

A Windows-first Dynamic Island that integrates WeChat, QQ, and email notifications, clipboard history, quick translation, a Codex status light, media controls, daily to-dos, and more.

fly-island runs as a lightweight, borderless, always-on-top floating island. It expands when needed and returns to a compact state when you're done, reducing how often you switch windows to get a single piece of information.

## Why I built it

In daily work or study, I often need to write a to-do list in one app. To block out noise, I open a music app and set the volume to just the right level. Work and study also often require translation websites, and I repeatedly copy and paste code. At the same time, it's hard to avoid messages from different group chats and friends.

Switching back and forth between these interfaces not only reduces efficiency but also easily distracts. So I started wondering: could these high-frequency features be integrated into one sufficiently lightweight place?

I thought of the iPhone's Dynamic Island, which gathers message notifications, timers, media controls, and other information onto one small island, shortening the path to getting information. That's how FocuSD was born. The name stands for **Focu Study and DeepWork**, meaning focused study and deep work. The project was developed with the lighter Tauri architecture, but it has since been renamed to fly-island.

## Features

The core problem fly-island aims to solve is the frequent window switching during work and study.

fly-island brings high-frequency operations scattered across different windows into a single collapsible, expandable floating island:

- **Image and text clipboard history**: Records copied text and images. Search by content or note, bookmark frequently used items, add notes, delete records, and copy items back to the clipboard with one click. History size, image records, and the global summon shortcut are all configurable.
- **QQ, WeChat, and QQ Mail**: Switch between QQ, WeChat, and Mail in a single brand navigation row, with tool buttons sharing one top row. QQ notifications and mail each keep the latest 20 items. Mail supports opening the body inside the island and returning to the list.
- **Quick translation**: Open a standalone translation window with a global shortcut. It automatically detects the Chinese-English direction or lets you set it manually. You can fill in the source text from the clipboard and copy the translation.
- **AI status light**: Shows whether a task is running, completed, or needs attention, via Codex and Claude Code lifecycle hooks. Hooks can be installed or repaired in settings.
- **To-dos, daily notes, and archive**: Manage today's tasks, mark them complete, and set the current task. Record daily notes and browse historical archives. Incomplete tasks can optionally carry over automatically, and tasks and notes can be saved as Markdown.
- **Music and system audio**: Skip to the previous track, play/pause, and skip to the next track through the Windows media session, and show audio activity with a dynamic waveform.
- **Appearance and startup settings**: Switch between classic or liquid glass appearance and system or pixel fonts. Adjust size, opacity, color, and top offset. Save up to 6 custom style presets, control title display, and launch at startup.

To-dos, clipboard, and app settings are stored locally. WeChat reminders only indicate that WeChat requested taskbar attention; they do not read chat content, senders, or exact unread counts. QQ notifications are kept only in memory for the current run; QQ…

molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## AirPlay Windows App
A receiver for AirPlay that supports multiple devices connected at the same time, supports real-time audio streaming and screen mirroring, and supports bidirectional control.  
Built with dotnet 10 and the WinUI 3 framework, with good performance.

For the core functionality implementation, see the [AirPlay.Core2](https://github.com/natsurainko/AirPlay.Core2) project.  

### Features

+ [x] Supports multiple devices connected to the AirPlay receiver at the same time
+ [x] Supports audio streaming from multiple devices in ALAC, AAC, and AAC-ELD formats
+ [x] Supports screen mirroring streams from multiple devices in H.264 format
+ [x] Supports adjusting mirroring stream resolution (1080p / 1440p / 2160p) and maximum frame rate (30 / 60 / 120 FPS) [requires target device support]
+ [x] Supports system media transport controls (Smtc) to reverse-control audio connections
+ [x] Supports the global shortcut `Windows + Alt + A` to quickly open the device control panel

### Screenshots

### Maintenance and Updates

The FFmpeg native DLLs in `AirPlay.App/Libraries` must match the version required by the FFmpeg.AutoGen bindings and the application architecture. When updating the bindings, also check the native libraries and project packaging entries.

rekazer0/keyskin.description: Visual editor for Baidu IME BDI and BDS skins
rekazer0/keyskin.body:
# KeySkin (键设)

A visual editor for Baidu IME iOS `.bdi` / Android `.bds` and `.bda` skins, and Sogou mobile IME `.ssf` / `.mssf` and Shouxin IME `.sxi` skins. It supports macOS, Windows and Android, and offers an online version usable in mobile browsers. It brings skin files, keyboard layouts, key styles and image assets into one live-preview workflow, with creating, editing, undo/redo, saving, cross-format conversion and sharing.

The desktop app uses a three-column layout: file navigator, live canvas and property inspector. The mobile version switches to an adjustable top/bottom split so you can move between files, canvas and properties. The interface supports light/dark mode, device safe areas and a lightweight frosted-glass effect. Skin files are always processed locally.

ruozhi521/ShiYin-MIT.body:
# 拾音（ShiYin）

An Android local music player built around lyrics: **tap any line of lyrics to jump straight to it**; **translate foreign-language lyrics with one tap, using either cloud AI or a local offline engine**; **for Japanese vocals or songs without lyrics, AI recognition generates timestamped lyrics in real time and translates them line by line**; **sleep timer**.

> ### 💝 Enjoying this project? Support the author
> 拾音 is completely free, ad-free, and has no in-app purchases. If you like it, feel free to buy the author a coffee on 爱发电. Every bit of encouragement keeps updates coming ❤️
> **爱发电 homepage: https://www.ifdian.net/a/ruozhi521**

---

## ⭐ Five Key Features

### 🎤 Lyric Recognition (Japanese · Experimental)

Japanese vocals or songs in your playlist have no lyric files? Let AI transcribe them.

- Settings → **Lyric Recognition (Japanese · Experimental)**. On first use, download the recognition model (about 165MB; **connects directly on mainland China networks without an accelerator**; the model is also stored on the device)
- On the full-screen lyrics page, tap “**Generate Lyrics**” → the currently playing song is recognized in real time: **lyrics appear as they are recognized**, and the progress dialog previews recognized lines live
- If a **script text file (.txt/.srt)** sits in the same directory as the audio, it is detected automatically and you are prompted to “recognize using the script.” The script serves as recognition hotwords, improving accuracy for proper nouns and names
- When a translation API is configured, **translation happens window by window in real time**: recognized lines are translated into Chinese immediately, so you see bilingual lyrics as soon as recognition finishes
- The generated `.lrc` is saved to the audio's directory and added to the library automatically. If recognition is cancelled midway, the completed parts are kept
- Recognition output is at “transcription draft” quality. Proper nouns may be wrong, and you can edit the lrc file manually

### 🌐 AI Lyric Translation

Can't understand a foreign song? Translate it into Chinese with one tap.

- On the full-screen lyrics page, tap “**译**.” The current song is translated line by line, with translations shown in small gray text beneath the original, scrolling with the highlight
- Compatible with **DeepSeek / Tongyi / GLM / Kimi** and any OpenAI-compatible API. Also supports **Baidu Translate / Youdao Translate** (Settings → Translation settings, where you enter your own API info)
- **API keys are stored only on the phone.** They are not in code and not uploaded, so privacy is preserved
- You can enable “**Auto-translate non-Chinese lyrics**” (off by default). Only non-Chinese lyrics are translated, and Chinese songs are skipped automatically. **Each song is translated only once**, and translations are cached locally so you are not charged repeatedly
- Fault-tolerant design: translation runs in batches. If individual lines fail, the rest are still translated, and failed lines can be retried with one tap
- **Cheaper for long transcripts**: during live recognition, translation is incremental. Only new lines are translated, so already translated content is not re-sent. If individual lines fail repeatedly, they are automatically circuit-broken and skipped, so you are not charged over and over

### 📴 Local Offline Translation

Don't want to go online or pay API fees? Install the translation model on your phone and run it **entirely locally**.

- Settings → Translation settings → choose provider “**Local offline (no internet required)**.” On first use, the model downloads (about 216MB; **connects directly on mainland China networks**; the model is stored on the device)
- Once downloaded, translation **sends nothing out, costs nothing, and never exposes lyrics**. Cloud AI…

worm-longliu/worm-vue3-print.body:
# worm-vue3-print

An open-source monorepo (npm workspaces) for a Vue 3 visual print template designer, template expression engine, and isomorphic rendering pipeline.

Design print templates by drag and drop, with data binding, expression evaluation, and pagination layout. All three ends share the same rendering and pagination algorithms (the logic has the same origin; pixel-level consistency also requires the same fonts and Chromium engine).
Implemented with pure Vue 3 and native HTML/CSS/SVG controls, with no dependency on any UI component library, so it can be integrated into any Vue 3 project.

> ⚠️ **Experimental capability notice**: `packages/print-common` (`@worm-vue3-print/common`) and the example `demo-common/` are **experimental**. They are intended to provide the designer as a zero-framework runtime (native custom elements) for **Vue 3 / Vue 2 / React / jQuery and other runtime frameworks** (including non-framework hosts). This package **has not yet completed stability testing**. It has been published to npm with a **formal version number** (dist-tag `latest`, currently `1.4.2`; install directly with `npm i @worm-vue3-print/common`). The npm page keeps the experimental notice and includes Vue 3 / Vue 2 / React usage examples. It is not recommended for production. For Vue 3 projects, use the mature `@worm-vue3-print/canvas`.

## 🔗 Online Preview

GitHub Pages: **https://worm-longliu.github.io/worm-vue3-print/**

> Static deployment. Supports only designer editing, browser preview, and browser-side printing. Server-side PDF and desktop client silent printing are not available.
